purpose: The starter script: checks Python 3.10+ and curses, then runs leeravontuur/__main__.main.
details: If Python is too old or curses is missing (Windows needs windows-curses from requirements.txt) it prints a short instruction instead of a traceback. The double-click files leeravontuur-win.bat, -mac.command and -linux.sh call this script.
module_docstring: Leeravontuur starten: python3 leeravontuur.py (hulp: python3 leeravontuur.py --help)
